name: Xbox system keyboard (Edge, Store, search)
notes: FALLBACK ONLY. This is the system on-screen keyboard (seen in Edge, Nov 2026). Apps that show it open a SmartGlass text session, so SystemText typing (instant) should be used instead; this layout is for when that fails. The side columns (#+=, cursor arrows, shift, enter) and the backspace key are left out on purpose: we never need them and the planner never moves into keys it doesn't know. Y = space, X = backspace. The keyboard seems to remember the last key, so the start key is a guess; use a fresh reset only when the highlight is known.
